# Sourdough loaf

Mix 500 g bread flour, 350 g water, 100 g active starter and 10 g salt. Rest for 30 minutes, then fold the dough every
half hour for two hours. Let it rise overnight in the fridge. Shape, proof for an hour, and bake in a Dutch oven at 250 C
for 20 minutes with the lid on and 20 more with it off. The crumb is open when the starter was fed 6 hours before mixing.
